description: An industry-level task management SaaS with a Next.js frontend, REST API backend, and pluggable persistence (JSON file for dev, PostgreSQL for production). Built by a multi-agent system of six specialized agents.

responsibilities: Define the product specification and acceptance criteria
Design the multi-agent collaboration protocol
Define the file ownership / attribution convention
Coordinate the work of all specialist agents
Approve the final release
Design the domain model and data layer
Implement the JSON-file persistence adapter (dev / preview)
Implement the PostgreSQL persistence adapter (production)
Implement input validation with Zod
Implement the REST API routes and response helpers
Build the Next.js App Router application shell
Implement the API client and formatting utilities
Build the dashboard page with statistics and project grid
Build the Kanban board page with task cards and modals
Scaffold build tooling: package.json, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, ESLint
Provide environment configuration templates
Add Dockerfile and docker-compose for containerized runs
Add vercel.json and a GitHub Actions CI pipeline
Write unit tests for validation and the JSON store
Write an integration test for the PostgreSQL adapter
Write an API smoke-test script
Run typecheck, tests, production build and live API smoke tests
Fix or escalate all defects found
Write the README with quickstart and feature overview
Document the system architecture and data model
Document the REST API reference
Document testing workflows
Write the step-by-step Vercel deployment guide

collaboration_protocol.trigger: project-manager-agent initiates each phase in order
collaboration_protocol.handoff: each agent completes its deliverables, then hands off to the next agent in the pipeline
collaboration_protocol.review: qa-testing-agent reviews every deliverable before release
collaboration_protocol.attribution: every source file carries a header comment naming the agent that created it

architecture.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router) + React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4
architecture.backend: Next.js Route Handlers exposing a REST API under /api
architecture.persistence: JSON file adapter (dev) or PostgreSQL adapter (production) behind a common DataStore interface
architecture.validation: Zod schemas shared by the API layer
